## About

I'm a Computer Science engineering student who found her way into growth marketing and never looked back. At Cartrabbit, I spent four months on Yuko Loyalty, learning by doing: understanding customers, working on product positioning, experimenting with approaches and figuring out how to communicate value.

My CS background lets me work comfortably with data and tools, from Power BI dashboards to automation workflows in n8n. My love for people shows up on stage: I hosted Cartrabbit's Annual Event 2026.

These days I look at every business through a marketing lens: what they sell, who it's for, and how I'd take it to market.

## Projects and case studies

### Meta Ad Library intelligence workflow
Automation · Competitor intelligence

An n8n automation that scrapes and analyses competitor ads from the Meta Ad Library, so ad research turns into a repeatable insight engine instead of a manual scroll.

Deliverables: n8n workflow, PDF insights report, Loom walkthrough. Tags: n8n, Meta Ad Library, Competitor ad analysis.

### Yuko Loyalty: turning loyal customers into repeat orders
Retention marketing · Cartrabbit

Brands were losing repeat customers. I worked on how Yuko Loyalty is positioned and messaged, and on outreach to brands, so the value of a loyalty and retention program lands with the right people.

Deliverables: Positioning, Messaging, Brand outreach. Tags: Retention, Loyalty, B2B SaaS.

### Power BI dashboard
Data · Certification work

A dashboard built during my Data Analytics using Power BI certification: turning raw data into a view a marketer can act on.

Deliverables: Data modelling, Dashboard design, Insight storytelling. Tags: Microsoft Power BI, Data analytics.
